scope: P1 portable parser integration and independent encoding review only; no build, deployment, new transport or physical-device assertion.

review.independentSerializer: youtubei.js FormatXTags.encode from installed generated protobuf schema
review.malformedBoundaryTests: Unit regressions cover truncated/duplicate/non-UTF8/oversized protobuf, 65-field limit, conflicting acont, DRC, DRM and implicit-original ambiguity.

discoveredAndFixed.issue: Browser atob accepts noncanonical trailing bits that native Rust base64 0.22 rejects.
discoveredAndFixed.fix: Require exact canonical URL_SAFE_NO_PAD, URL_SAFE or STANDARD roundtrip.

discoveredAndFixed.issue: Default TextDecoder strips a leading UTF-8 BOM, unlike native str::from_utf8.
discoveredAndFixed.fix: Use fatal UTF-8 with ignoreBOM:true to preserve BOM as data; it cannot become original identity.

comparison.p1: Known tabbed or flat section containers, recognized empty tabs, rejection of API error/ERROR alert.
Explicit original marker required across all encodings once any audio track/language metadata is present; DRC/DRM/dub/contradiction rejected.
comparison.pwa: Same policy with bounded FormatXTags protobuf; wholly untagged MP4 remains compatible.

comparison.p1: Extractor checks the requested video identity.
comparison.pwa: status OK now additionally requires exact valid videoDetails.videoId.

comparison.p1: Native formats may include Opus or other ordered codecs.
comparison.pwa: Existing direct MP4 selection retained; no speculative Opus or cipher support added.

comparison.p1: Rust HTTP, anonymous bootstrap, decoder and privileged capture APIs.
comparison.pwa: Unchanged normal browser transport/session; parser changes do not overcome bootstrap/CDN CORS or supply captured bytes.
